title: Rodland of Pipes
description:
Rodland of Pipes is a game about crawling through pipes.

The pipes are cramped, making turning around impossible. Plan a route if you want to make it out in time.

You’re not alone down here, don’t let yourself become an easy meal.

But just who is Rodland? Is he really running a small plumbing business or is something more sinister in motion?
Features:A colorful cast of pipe denizens to discover. Each with unique AI, mechanics, and a hand animated jumpscare.
Randomized elements, every journey into the pipes is unique
Adjustable difficulty
Rich immersive audio
Secrets!
Custom level editor
An estimated 3-4 hours for a full playthrough
A song at the very end
description_short: Crawl through pipes, navigate the maze, listen carefully and get out before Rodland finds you.
